summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by reading and editing files only; tests were not run, per the instructions. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, level counter, 4 cells per level, max_width passed through unchanged) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or min of that and an explicit width), and adds the VerticalCenter class (render with newline padding from console.size.height, measurement delegated, repr, JupyterMixin). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in the render options of print while still passing justify to _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added section containing the two entries. tests/test_tree.py adds test_measure and test_measure_single_node; tests/test_align.py adds repr, VerticalCenter render/no-padding/measure, and Align width-constraint tests. Nothing was committed. Unverified: the Align width-constraint expected string (8 leading, 9 trailing spaces) was counted by hand and may need adjustment once the suite runs.
